name: Chris Davenport
source:
Chris is an upperclassmen who takes on a mentorship role for Ben. He's Ben's university-appointed "Student Mentor", guiding him through the first semester with advice and support.

[Based on [url=https://stormsingerstudios.itch.io/santa-lucia]itch.io[/url]]

NOTE: He will get an individual route in future builds.
